description: Plan v7 section 8.3 runtime-limits clause: maximumGeneratedPlaceholderDepth pinned exactly at 2. DefaultStrings.interpolateTemplate enters a generated placeholder's template at recursion depth k and throws when depth > limit (DefaultStrings.java:1321), so with the limit at 2 the depth-0, depth-1 and depth-2 keys all resolve and only the depth-3 chain trips. Lowering the limit rather than building a 33-link chain keeps the boundary exact and the fixture readable. One loaded locale, so no language code is ambiguous.
